mindmap.central_theme: Family relationships, observation, humor, and everyday mindfulness

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: The humorous situations caused by absent-mindedness in daily domestic life.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Simple solutions are often right in front of us if we observe calmly rather than panicking.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Empathy towards elders, observant behavior in children, and shared family affection.

child_nodes.title: Beginning
child_nodes.details: Papa misplaces his reading spectacles and begins a frantic household search.

child_nodes.title: Mid-point
child_nodes.details: Family members assist by searching pockets, drawers, tables, and under chairs.

child_nodes.title: Climax
child_nodes.details: An observant young child notices the spectacles resting on top of Papa's forehead.

child_nodes.title: Resolution
child_nodes.details: Laughter fills the room as Papa realizes his mistake and thanks his child.

child_nodes.title: Papa
child_nodes.details: Absent-minded, affectionate father who relies heavily on reading glasses.

child_nodes.title: Observant Child
child_nodes.details: Attentive, calm, and helpful young narrator who solves the domestic mystery.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Spectacles, glanced, misplaced, frantic, anxious, observant.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: Three-syllable word 'spec-ta-cles'; soft ending in 'glanced' (/t/ sound).

child_nodes.title: Silent Letters
child_nodes.details: Silent 'k' in 'know'; silent 'w' in 'write'.

child_nodes.title: Nouns & Noun Phrases
child_nodes.details: Identification of concrete nouns (glasses, chair, pocket) and plural forms.

child_nodes.title: Contractions
child_nodes.details: Usage of can't (cannot), where's (where is), he's (he is).

child_nodes.title: Sentence Types
child_nodes.details: Interrogative questions ('Where are my glasses?') and Exclamatory statements.

mindmap.central_theme: Childhood outdoor play, joy of sports, unpredictable fun, and companionship

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: Spontaneity, sportsmanship, and unexpected humorous events during outdoor play.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Laughter and adaptable joy make innocent mishaps enjoyable memories.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Encouraging physical activity, teamwork, and taking unexpected twists with humor.

child_nodes.title: Beginning
child_nodes.details: Gopi hears a strange rustle among leaves, finds a hockey ball, and joins friends.

child_nodes.title: Mid-point
child_nodes.details: Jay demonstrates dribbling techniques; an intense neighbourhood match begins.

child_nodes.title: Climax
child_nodes.details: A powerful strike clears the boundary and lands right in a passing scooter's basket.

child_nodes.title: Resolution
child_nodes.details: The unaware scooter driver rides away with the ball; children burst into laughter.

child_nodes.title: Gopi
child_nodes.details: Curious, energetic young boy who discovers the ball and loves sports.

child_nodes.title: Jay
child_nodes.details: Skilled teammate who teaches proper hockey stick grip and dribbling.

child_nodes.title: Scooter Driver
child_nodes.details: Unsuspecting passerby who involuntarily becomes part of the game.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Dribble, rustle, grabbed, thud, unaware, coincidence, basket.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: Double vowels in 'scooter' (/uː/) and '-gh-' sound in 'laughter' (/f/).

child_nodes.title: Silent Letters
child_nodes.details: Silent 't' in 'rustle'; silent 'w' in 'wrist'.

child_nodes.title: Adverbs of Frequency
child_nodes.details: Identifying always, often, sometimes, rarely, and never in daily action contexts.

child_nodes.title: Action Verbs
child_nodes.details: Past tense dynamic verbs: dribbled, bounced, tightened, zoomed.

child_nodes.title: Prepositions of Place
child_nodes.details: Under the bush, into the basket, across the boundary gate.

mindmap.central_theme: Nature's supreme aesthetic beauty versus human engineering

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: Natural wonders (clouds, rainbows) surpass man-made creations (boats, bridges).

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Human architecture is functional and grand, but nature's creations possess divine beauty.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Appreciating the environment, observation of atmospheric science, and poetic reflection.

child_nodes.title: Stanza 1
child_nodes.details: Boats sail on rivers and ships sail on seas, but clouds across sky are prettier.

child_nodes.title: Stanza 2
child_nodes.details: Bridges exist on rivers, but the rainbow bridges earth to sky over tops of trees.

child_nodes.title: Poetic Conclusion
child_nodes.details: Nature constructs a colorful bridge to heaven far prettier than any man-made arch.

child_nodes.title: The Poet (Christina Rossetti)
child_nodes.details: Observant speaker admiring atmospheric grandeur.

child_nodes.title: Man-made Objects
child_nodes.details: Boats, ships, and river bridges representing human skill.

child_nodes.title: Natural Wonders
child_nodes.details: Clouds, sky, and the majestic seven-colored rainbow bow.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Sail, overtops, bow, heaven, prettier, spectrum, VIBGYOR, prism.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: Diphthong /eɪ/ in 'rain' and /əʊ/ in 'bow'.

child_nodes.title: Silent Letters
child_nodes.details: Silent 'd' in 'bridge'; silent 'gh' in 'high'.

child_nodes.title: Degrees of Comparison
child_nodes.details: Comparative adjectives: pretty -> prettier; grand -> grander.

child_nodes.title: Verbs of Motion
child_nodes.details: Distinction between 'sailing' (boats/clouds) and 'building' (bridges).

child_nodes.title: Scientific Integration
child_nodes.details: Refraction of light through moisture droplets creating VIBGYOR.

mindmap.central_theme: Freedom, wit, solidarity, strategic thinking, and avian conservation

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: The innate human and animal desire for freedom above material luxury.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Intelligence and collective wisdom can overcome physical bondage and power.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Value liberty over comfort; clever strategies succeed where force fails.

child_nodes.title: Beginning
child_nodes.details: A wealthy merchant keeps a caged talking parrot; prepares to travel to its homeland.

child_nodes.title: Mid-point
child_nodes.details: Merchant meets wild parrots; when he conveys greetings, a wild bird feigns death and falls.

child_nodes.title: Climax
child_nodes.details: Merchant returns and narrates this; the caged parrot understands the code and plays dead.

child_nodes.title: Resolution
child_nodes.details: Merchant sorrowfully places 'dead' bird on window sill; bird instantly flies to freedom.

child_nodes.title: The Caged Parrot
child_nodes.details: Intelligent, observant bird that seeks freedom over golden comfort.

child_nodes.title: The Merchant
child_nodes.details: Rich, well-meaning owner who unknowingly passes the secret escape strategy.

child_nodes.title: The Wild Parrots
child_nodes.details: Wise jungle flock that communicates a silent message of liberation.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Merchant, feigned, sorrowfully, motionless, captivity, flock, strategy.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: Soft 'ch' in 'merchant'; '-less' suffix in 'motionless'.

child_nodes.title: Silent Letters
child_nodes.details: Silent 'g' in 'feigned'; silent 't' in 'stretched'.

child_nodes.title: Adverbs of Manner
child_nodes.details: Describing actions: sorrowfully laid, silently watched, joyfully flew.

child_nodes.title: Direct & Indirect Speech
child_nodes.details: Reporting greetings and news between merchant and parrots.

child_nodes.title: Wildlife Integration
child_nodes.details: Informational focus on Indian bird sanctuaries (Bharatpur, Ranganathittu).

mindmap.central_theme: Amphibian life cycle, biological adaptation, and environmental harmony

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: Understanding nature through the biological metamorphosis of amphibians.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Every living creature plays a vital role in ecological balance and pest control.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Respecting aquatic habitats, observing growth stages, and nature appreciation.

child_nodes.title: Stage 1: Eggs & Tadpole
child_nodes.details: Eggs hatch into aquatic tadpoles breathing through gills and swimming with tails.

child_nodes.title: Stage 2: Metamorphosis
child_nodes.details: Tadpoles grow hind legs, then forelegs, and gradually absorb their tail.

child_nodes.title: Stage 3: Adult Frog
child_nodes.details: Adult frog develops lungs and webbed feet, living comfortably on land and water.

child_nodes.title: The Frog
child_nodes.details: Versatile amphibian with moist skin, sticky tongue, and powerful hind legs.

child_nodes.title: Tadpole
child_nodes.details: Water-dwelling larval form that demonstrates biological growth stages.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Webbed feet, amphibian, tadpole, metamorphosis, habitat, predator, gills, damp.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: 'ph' sounding like '/f/' in 'amphibian'; short vowel /ɛ/ in 'webbed'.

child_nodes.title: Silent Letters
child_nodes.details: Silent 't' in 'catch'; silent 'ue' in 'tongue'.

child_nodes.title: Present Continuous Tense
child_nodes.details: Describing ongoing processes: 'is growing legs', 'is swimming'.

child_nodes.title: Cause and Effect Structures
child_nodes.details: Because frogs have webbed feet, they swim fast in water.

child_nodes.title: Aquatic Wildlife Fact
child_nodes.details: Ganges River Dolphin recognized as India's national aquatic animal.

mindmap.central_theme: Water conservation, cultural creativity, resource management, and rainwater harvesting

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: The crucial necessity of saving water combined with regional cultural expressions.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Water is a finite, precious treasure; community conservation requires daily mindfulness.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Preventing waste, designing rainwater harvesting systems, and environmental duty.

child_nodes.title: Part 1: The Crisis
child_nodes.details: A scorching summer day leads to tap water scarcity, raising awareness about supply.

child_nodes.title: Part 2: Cultural Architecture
child_nodes.details: Exploration of Punjab's rooftop tanks built in fun custom shapes (tractors, aeroplanes).

child_nodes.title: Part 3: Traditional Conservation
child_nodes.details: Study of Rajasthan's underground 'Tankas' for clean rainwater harvesting.

child_nodes.title: Resolution
child_nodes.details: Children create slogans and pledge to save every drop of precious water.

child_nodes.title: School Children
child_nodes.details: Active eco-ambassadors creating slogans and practicing water conservation.

child_nodes.title: Punjabi Artisans
child_nodes.details: Creative builders constructing artistic rooftop overhead tanks.

child_nodes.title: Rajasthani Villagers
child_nodes.details: Masters of traditional underground rainwater harvesting methods.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Conservation, shortage, rainwater harvesting, Tankas, slogans, reservoir, precious.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: Four-syllable word 'con-ser-va-tion'; ending '-tion' (/ʃən/).

child_nodes.title: Silent Letters
child_nodes.details: Silent 'l' in 'shouldn't'; silent 't' in 'whistle'.

child_nodes.title: Modal Auxiliaries
child_nodes.details: Expressing duty: should, must, ought to ('We must save every drop').

child_nodes.title: Negative Contractions
child_nodes.details: Mastery of shouldn't, couldn't, wouldn't, haven't, mustn't.

child_nodes.title: Imperative Slogans
child_nodes.details: Command forms used in awareness campaigns ('Turn off taps!').

mindmap.central_theme: Traditional Indian outdoor games, fair play, abstract concepts, and sportsmanship

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: Preserving indigenous street games that foster camaraderie and physical agility.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Honesty, fair play, and mutual respect matter far more than score points.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Outdoor play builds resilience, friendship, and understanding of fair boundaries.

child_nodes.title: Equipment Prep
child_nodes.details: Crafting the wooden gilli (tapered peg) and danda (striking stick).

child_nodes.title: Gameplay Mechanics
child_nodes.details: Flicking gilli from groove, striking mid-air, and fielders attempting catches.

child_nodes.title: Game Experience
child_nodes.details: Children play passionately while practicing fair play and handling disputes calmly.

child_nodes.title: The Striker
child_nodes.details: Focused player measuring distance and striking the tapered peg.

child_nodes.title: Fielding Friends
child_nodes.details: Agile teammates working together to catch the airborne wooden peg.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Gilli, danda, traditional, tapered, sportsmanship, groove, indigenous.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: Hard 'g' in 'gilli'; double consonant 'll' and short vowels.

child_nodes.title: Silent Letters
child_nodes.details: Silent 'h' in 'whack'; silent 'g' in 'design'.

child_nodes.title: Abstract Nouns
child_nodes.details: Identifying non-physical qualities: joy, sportsmanship, courage, truth.

child_nodes.title: Possessive Pronouns
child_nodes.details: Expressing ownership: mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs.

child_nodes.title: Prefixes
child_nodes.details: Adding un-, dis-, im- to change word meanings (kind -> unkind).

mindmap.central_theme: Grassroots justice, moral integrity, wisdom over greed, and community ethics

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: Traditional Indian village governance delivering fair, clever, and impartial justice.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Deceit and greed eventually backfire when confronted by wise, unbiased leadership.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Stand up against exploitation; integrity and truth always triumph.

child_nodes.title: The Conflict
child_nodes.details: A farmer buys a well, but the deceitful seller demands extra payment for water.

child_nodes.title: The Appeal
child_nodes.details: The aggrieved farmer seeks justice from the village Panchayat council.

child_nodes.title: The Wise Ruling
child_nodes.details: The Chief rules: if water belongs to seller, seller must pay rent for storing it in farmer's well!

child_nodes.title: Resolution
child_nodes.details: The deceitful seller apologizes, relinquishes claim, and justice is served.

child_nodes.title: The Honest Farmer
child_nodes.details: Hardworking, humble, and trusting man who relies on village council justice.

child_nodes.title: The Deceitful Seller
child_nodes.details: Greedy neighbor who tries to exploit wordings to cheat his buyer.

child_nodes.title: Panchayat Chief
child_nodes.details: Wise, sharp-witted elder who outsmarts the cheat with brilliant logic.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Panchayat, dispute, deceitful, verdict, relinquish, outwitted, irrigate.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: Soft 'ch' in 'Panchayat'; hard 'c' in 'verdict'.

child_nodes.title: Silent Letters
child_nodes.details: Silent 'h' in 'honest'; silent 'e' in 'judgment'.

child_nodes.title: Suffixes
child_nodes.details: Forming words with -ful, -less, -ment (deceitful, careless, judgment).

child_nodes.title: Conditional Clauses
child_nodes.details: If-then logic ('If you own the water, then pay rent for the well storage').

child_nodes.title: Moral Inspiration
child_nodes.details: Biographical link to Sri Ramakrishna Paramahamsa on truth and unity.

mindmap.central_theme: Childhood innocence, longing for unrestricted freedom, and dignity of labor

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: A child's imaginative perspective admiring outdoor workers' apparent total freedom.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Every profession holds dignity, though grass looks greener on the other side.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Appreciating hard labor, understanding adult responsibilities, and creative imagery.

child_nodes.title: Morning (10 AM)
child_nodes.details: Child walks to school, meets bangle hawker; wishes for unscheduled freedom.

child_nodes.title: Afternoon (4 PM)
child_nodes.details: Child returns home, sees gardener digging earth; wishes to dig without scolding.

child_nodes.title: Night (Bedtime)
child_nodes.details: Child looks from window, sees night watchman with lantern; wishes to chase shadows.

child_nodes.title: The Schoolchild
child_nodes.details: Imaginative, constrained young narrator yearning for unrestricted independence.

child_nodes.title: The Hawker
child_nodes.details: Sells crystal bangles with no fixed time, hurry, or set road.

child_nodes.title: The Gardener
child_nodes.details: Soil-covered worker digging freely with his spade under the sun.

child_nodes.title: The Watchman
child_nodes.details: Night worker walking lonely streets swinging a glowing lantern.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Vocation, hawker, spade, lantern, lonely, simile, reprimand, giant.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: Diphthong sound in 'hawker'; '-tion' ending in 'vocation'.

child_nodes.title: Silent Letters
child_nodes.details: Silent 'gh' in 'night'; silent 'w' in 'shadow'.

child_nodes.title: Figurative Language (Simile)
child_nodes.details: Comparing objects: 'The street-lamp stands like a giant with one red eye.'

child_nodes.title: Prepositions of Movement
child_nodes.details: Through the lane, past the gate, down the dark alley.

child_nodes.title: Expressing Wishes
child_nodes.details: Subjunctive structure: 'I wish I were a hawker...'

mindmap.central_theme: Traditional craftsmanship, family legacy, innovation, and community upliftment

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: Blending heritage craftsmanship with modern education and design innovation.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Education empowers youth to revitalize traditional family heritage and boost local economy.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Generational collaboration, entrepreneurial spirit, and pride in traditional skills.

child_nodes.title: The Heritage
child_nodes.details: Ravi works at hot furnaces in Firozabad, crafting traditional glass bangles.

child_nodes.title: The Innovation
child_nodes.details: Educated daughter Ananya introduces fresh floral patterns and modern colour palettes.

child_nodes.title: The Success
child_nodes.details: Festive Diwali collection receives massive orders, reviving workshop prosperity.

child_nodes.title: Community Impact
child_nodes.details: Expanded production creates jobs in packaging, logistics, and sales for villagers.

child_nodes.title: Ravi
child_nodes.details: Experienced, hardworking glass artisan preserving family heritage.

child_nodes.title: Ananya
child_nodes.details: Creative, educated daughter who bridges tradition with modern market design.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Artisan, furnace, innovation, illuminated, heritage, molten, collaborate, Firozabad.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: Three-syllable word 'ar-ti-san'; ending '-tion' in 'innovation'.

child_nodes.title: Silent Letters
child_nodes.details: Silent 'g' in 'design'; silent 'e' in 'furnace'.

child_nodes.title: Past Perfect Tense
child_nodes.details: Expressing earlier completed events: 'Ananya had completed her studies before returning.'

child_nodes.title: Proper Nouns
child_nodes.details: Specific capital names: Firozabad, Diwali, Ravi, Ananya.

child_nodes.title: Socio-Economic Link
child_nodes.details: Understanding how local art drives regional transport and retail employment.
